Dear Sir
I send you my own autograph, together with a few more, chiefly of authors.

If in return you could send me some stamps that have been through the post, local and the like, I should be much obliged.

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: On the other side of the card is pasted a photograph cut from a newspaper or magazine, captioned ‘Miss Charlotte M.

Yonge.

From a photograph by Messrs.

Elliot & Fry, 55, Baker Street, W.’.
